request_payload.title: Antisense oligonucleotide therapy for KCNT1 encephalopathy.

mentions.sentence: De novo variants in ion channels, including gain-of-function variants in KCNT1, which encodes for sodium activated potassium channel protein KNa1.1, have been found to play a major role in the etiology of EIMFS.
